Generate HF gas by adding calcium fluoride to concentrated H₂SO₄ in a separate vessel; bubble the HF into the reaction mixture over 30 min, maintaining temperature below –60 °C. 4. Separate the organic layer, dry over anhydrous MgSO₄, and filter through activated charcoal to remove impurities. 7. Wear full PPE (acid‑resistant suit, double gloves, face shield). Keep calcium fluoride and H₂SO₄ apart from all other reagents until the HF generation step. Maintain a sealed containment area and have a neutralizing station (Ca(OH)₂ slurry) ready for spills. **Disposal/Decontamination**: Neutralize waste with a stoichiometric excess of calcium hydroxide slurry, then incinerate at >1200 °C in a dedicated hazardous‑waste furnace.
